name: Mitsuwa
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Mitsuwa mourns a group of trolls slain on their journey through Ashenvale. He calls on Horde champions to recover their stolen charms.

sections.title: Avenging the Fallen Kin
sections.body: At Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, Mitsuwa serves the Horde alongside Marukai. Thistlefur furbolgs from northern Ashenvale ambushed and slaughtered a group of traveling trolls bound for the outpost. Mitsuwa sees their deaths as a grave offense. He sends warriors to the Thistlefur dens to reclaim the stolen charms and honor his kin's spirits.

faq.answer: Mitsuwa is a Darkspear jungle troll at Zoram'gar Outpost in northwestern Ashenvale. He watches over the post alongside Marukai and directs the response to nearby threats.

faq.q: What happened to the trolls traveling to Zoram'gar?
faq.answer: Thistlefur furbolgs ambushed and slaughtered a group of trolls traveling across Ashenvale to Zoram'gar Outpost. The furbolgs took the fallen trolls' possessions.

faq.q: Why are the troll charms so important to Mitsuwa?
faq.answer: For the Darkspear, the charms carry spiritual and cultural meaning. Leaving the sacred relics with the Thistlefur furbolgs dishonors the spirits of the slain.
The Thistlefur furbolgs carried the charms to their village and den in northern Ashenvale, east of the Zoram Strand.

angles.text: For Darkspear adventurers, Mitsuwa's call is personal. Recovering ancestral charms from the furbolgs honors their murdered kin and brings peace to their spirits.
Zoram'gar Outpost is an isolated garrison under siege. Helping Mitsuwa strengthens the Horde's precarious position against wild beasts and Alliance scouts in western Kalimdor.
